name: slider
label: Slider
description: A range slider for picking a value within a range. Themed with the primary accent color across browsers, with an optional label and live value readout. Works with wire:model.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional label rendered above the slider.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the current value next to the label.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A labeled slider with a live value readout, and a bare one.
